sql: SELECT o.currency,p.id AS product_id,p.sku,p.title,COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.refund_amount),0) AS value,COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price),0) AS gross_sales,COALESCE(SUM(i.refund_amount),0) AS refund_amount,COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.refund_amount),0) AS net_sales FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id AND i.store_id=o.store_id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id AND p.store_id=o.store_id WHERE o.store_id=?
